historical_p0.source: unchanged frozen INVO seven website signals and shared v6.1 simulator
historical_p0.window: 2026-04-01 through 2026-09-30 inclusive UTC; retrospective reused data

future_p1_regime_hypotheses.source: Completed 5-minute candles only, with no future price information
future_p1_regime_hypotheses.rule_design: Observe, do not filter. 2-hour return and mean recent range are labeled descriptively using only prior completed bars.
future_p1_regime_hypotheses.comparison: All frozen baseline signals vs each prior-time regime; no trade omission in production
future_p1_regime_hypotheses.gate: Separate prospective registration and independent forward data, minimum 100 total and 30 per group are inspection floors, not approval
future_p1_regime_hypotheses.data_policy: Never backfill previously seen signals or relabel historical candles as forward

constraints: No changes to production or v7 existing registration
No strategy parameters selected from six-month held-out data
No use of unrealized holdings without position data
